Built around four gain stages , two of which host dedicated clipping circuits, it delivers a rich, harmonic-laden tone with a bold, unmistakable personality. Every note blooms with texture and power. Tone control is handled by a classic subtractive EQ circuit: the more you turn the knob up, the more the pedal opens up, letting a wider range of frequencies through and revealing the true voice of the Sun Drive. With the Tone fully open, the circuit reaches its full range—but you’ll also want to adjust the gain, as the harmonic content increases proportionally with sustain. It’s a system that invites exploration, helping you find your ideal balance between saturation and tone. The Moon Drive is equipped with the always-active Costalab Class A buffer , designed to preserve signal integrity, enhance note definition, and eliminate radio interference. It also includes a ground loop circuit to ensure silent, noise-free operation—even in complex signal chains. + Detail - Detail For optimal performance, the Moon Drive is best powered through an isolated power supply or a classic Boss-style PSA adapter . It accepts 9V DC center-negative power via standard 2.1mm barrel plug, with a current draw of less than 20 mA . As with all Costalab products, the Moon Drive is built with premium-grade components for ultra-low noise operation. It features a buffered bypass switching system and an anti-pop filter for smooth, click-free engagement that maintains signal clarity and dynamics. We recommend using our filtered and stabilized GIOVE power supply , or a unit of equivalent quality. Using unfiltered or unregulated adapters may introduce noise or damage the pedal. Its compact dimensions (60 x 111 x 30 mm, excluding knobs and jacks ) make it an easy fit even on the most crowded pedalboards—without compromising on sonic performance.
